# Permission Request for Portable Air Conditioner

## Email Draft
Subject: Request for Approval to Install a Portable Air Conditioner

Dear [Landlord’s Name],

I hope you are well. I am writing to ask for your permission to install a portable air conditioner in my rented apartment in Berlin. With the recent warm weather, it would help me keep the apartment comfortable while I work and sleep.

I want to reassure you that I will use only a portable unit that requires no permanent installation and will not damage the property. I will follow all manufacturer instructions carefully and take full responsibility for proper use and maintenance.

If approved, I will also remove the unit completely when I move out and restore the apartment to its original condition.

I have always paid rent on time and value being a reliable tenant. If you are happy to approve this, I would be grateful for your written confirmation.

Kind regards,
[Your Name]
